observations: Photo 0 shows a black mirrorless camera with a lens attached, placed on a blue textured surface. The camera body has 'LUMIX' and 'G' visible on the top. The lens has '14-140' written on it.

Photo 1 shows the same camera from a top-down angle with the LCD screen open, displaying 'Please set the clock'. The camera body has 'LUMIX' and 'G' visible. A battery and a charger are placed next to the camera.
The camera appears to be in used condition with some minor scuffs and dust, especially on the lens and body.
The charger is labeled 'LUMIX' and has a slot for a battery.
The battery is labeled 'LUMIX' and has a capacity sticker, but the exact capacity is not legible.
No visible damage to the body or lens, but no close-up shots of the screen, buttons, or ports.

claims.claim: Neatly used Lumix G7 mirrorless camera.
claims.evidence: The brand 'Lumix' is visible in both photos, but the model 'G7' is not readable on the camera body or lens. The seller's text claims it, but no photo confirms the model.
Photo 1 shows two batteries and one charger next to the camera.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The camera may not be a Lumix G7, but a different model or a counterfeit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera body showing the model name, typically on the top or bottom plate.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Lumix G7, which may be less valuable than a genuine G7.

risks.risk: The camera may not power on or may have a faulty shutter or sensor.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying the shutter count or menu.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, since functionality cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: The batteries may be dead or not hold a charge.
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the camera operating on battery power for at least 30 seconds.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing new batteries, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The charger may not be compatible or may be damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the charger's ports and a test video showing it charging the battery.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing a new charger, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Photo of the camera body showing the model name (e.g., G7).
Video or photo of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Photo or video showing the camera operating on battery power for at least 30 seconds.
Photo of the charger's ports and a test video showing it charging the battery.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
